elements.element: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its affiliates
elements.evidence: HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates

elements.element: Third-party claims alleging services/deliverables infringe IP
elements.evidence: any allegation that the Site, the services performed by HDI hereunder or any materials, software or technology provided by HDI ... infringe or misappropriate any patent, copyright, trademark, trade secret or other intellectual property right of a third party

elements.element: Claims arising from Vendor's breach of law
elements.evidence: (b) HDI's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation
(c) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Content, Confidential Information or user or customer data caused by HDI
(d) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct
shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any claim
shall permit the indemnifying Party to control the defense and settlement of the claim
shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying Party's expense

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content
elements.evidence: any allegation that the Content or Marks furnished by the Company and used by HDI in accordance with this Agreement infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right of a third party

elements.element: Customer indemnity limited to Customer's breach of law
elements.evidence: or out of the Company's breach of applicable law
any allegation that the Site, the services performed by HDI hereunder ... infringe or misappropriate any ... intellectual property right of a third party
only exclusion is '(excluding the Content and Marks provided by the Company)'; no modification/combination/specification carve-outs
no procure/modify/replace/refund remedy language appears in 9A

elements.element: Vendor indemnity subject to super-cap of 3x annual fees
elements.evidence: no cap or super-cap referenced in the inserted clause

reasons: All ten atomic preferred elements are present: Vendor defence/indemnity for Customer and affiliates, IP infringement of the Site/services/materials, Vendor breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct, notice/control/cooperation procedure, and a Customer indemnity confined to Customer-supplied Content/Marks and Customer's breach of law.

Fallback is incomplete (no modification/combination/specification exclusions, no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, no 3x super-cap), but the locked target is preferred, which is satisfied; the two levels are not mixed.

The Agreement had no indemnity at all, so a concise inserted clause is the minimal fix; the added officers/directors/employees language is customary indemnified-party scope and does not expand the bargain.

No untouched sentence is disturbed: clause 9(b) and the Globix carve-out remain effective, and the new 9A uses existing defined terms (Content, Marks, Site, Confidential Information) without creating dangling mechanics.
